status: specification only — the renderer builds its own validated turn array from prompts/episode-writer.md at generation time; this file documents the contract and is NOT episode data
carried_over: 2026-09-18 from the predecessor repository, read in full before transfer

david.name: David
david.role: Co-host — grounding, gut checks, BS filter. Also the Editorial and Content Lead seat; the seat and the host are one identity.

jason.name: Jason
jason.role: Co-host — clinical literature, procedural frameworks, calibrated reactions. Also the Chief of Staff seat; the seat and the host are one identity.
jason.sentence_style: low-affect; lets David push, then reframes with precision

rules: speakers are exactly David or Jason — Logan and Cross are retired
emotional_key must belong to the speaker's set
pause_after_ms stays within 200–400; 400 is the absolute ceiling
reactions are written as words, never stage directions; no non-spoken laughter
cut-offs end with a dash (—) and trigger a 200ms cut-in; trailing off uses ellipses (...)
fillers and stutters roughly one in every four to five turns; a filler replaces a pause
no medical advice — tag NOT_MEDICAL and rephrase toward gear, practice, and community
required terms of art: Internal Courtroom, Ambiguity Tax, Double Outsider, Somatic Scaffolding, Radical Acceptance. Definitions live in the Glossary of Terms of Art, which is the single source.
retired_rules: "gear, not medicine" — retired as a required phrase 2026-09-18. The framing still governs how gear and kink material are written; it is no longer a rule line. Recorded here rather than deleted so a reader arriving from the predecessor file can see where it went.

engine.sectioning: three sections — Section 1 = cold open + Beats 1–2; Section 2 = Beats 3–4; Section 3 = Beats 5–6 + closing
engine.target: 36–40 min, 5,400–6,400 words, 145–175 turns; each section 1,800–2,150 words
engine.target_set: 2026-09-29 — supersedes the inherited 25–30 min / 5,000–7,000 word target, which was also below the renderer's own 20-minute truncation warning
